definitions.FORMAL_DATA_READY: Historical market-data/provenance gate only; does not imply feature, strategy, model, or OOS readiness.
definitions.FEATURE_INPUT_READY: All frozen candidate feature families have validated point-in-time inputs and provenance.
definitions.STRATEGY_READY: Authoritative strategy code, factor definitions, parameters, normalization, aggregation and trade rules are fully recovered or separately approved.
definitions.MODEL_FROZEN: A specific strategy package is frozen and hash-bound to Formal inputs, universe and calendar.
definitions.OOS_ADMITTED: Formal, model freeze, OOS scope and isolation gates all pass exact hash-linked admission.

current_state.formal_data_ready_reason: V4.82 mathematical/row-level Formal closure exists, but Audit Remediation V1 byte-bound reissue has not yet been materialized from exact production files.

hard_boundaries: UNAPPROVED GP12 candidate never implies STRATEGY_READY
Missing historical GP V1.1 strategy code/parameters/factor definitions keeps STRATEGY_READY false
MODEL_FROZEN requires an explicit hash-bound model package
OOS_ADMITTED requires a separate exact admission decision
